text_block_list.text: During a dance lesson with Hishi Akebono...
(—*flex flex!*)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
—And strike a pose~☆ Trainer-san,
what do you think~? How was my dance?
choice_data_list: It's got so much power, I love it!
It's got so much power, I love it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Right~! I tried incorporating
some sumo-like moves into the choreography~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! Sumo moves are
so powerful, it's really fun to watch~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I want to make the audience just as happy at the live show
as sumo wrestlers do~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... But compared to sumo,
I feel like it's still lacking that "dosukoi" punch...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
How can I make my dance
have more impact~?
choice_data_list: Bring a guest onto the stage

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Forward... Oh, I get it! If I get all the way to the front, everyone will see me super up close~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, let's go~! I'm gonna keep plowing ahead,
so watch my buono dance from the front row splash seats!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho, hup~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Dos, koi☆ Dos, koi☆
Underarm throw, boom!!

...It's so close I can't see anything.
Though with this kind of presence,
maybe it's not so bad.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You're going to... bring an audience member
up onto the stage?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I seeee! If we dance facing each other up close,
it'll be just as intense as a sumo match~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Then Trainer-san, come up front, come on.
Let's lock hands and dance head-to-head~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Thrust 'em out♪ Push 'em out♪
Dos, koi, ko~i!!!!!!
(Boom!! Dun-dun-duuun!!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, we bumped into each other~! Did Mount Akebono... win?

I got sent flying. But every now and then,
fan service like this might actually be a hit with the fans.
